description: Total monthly housing cost (PITI): principal+interest plus property tax, homeowners insurance, PMI, and HOA, so affordability reflects real monthly outlay. If no rate is supplied, the current best market rate for the state is used.

annual_insurance.description: Homeowners insurance in dollars/year. Default max(800, 0.35% of home price).

credit_score.description: Optional borrower credit score, used for the market-rate lookup.

down_payment.description: Cash down payment in dollars. Default 0. loan_amount = home_price - down_payment.

home_price.description: Purchase price in dollars. Required unless loan_amount is given.

loan_amount.description: Optional explicit loan amount; overrides home_price - down_payment.

pmi_rate.description: Annual PMI as % of loan balance. Default 0.5, applied only when LTV > 80%.

property_tax_rate.description: Annual property tax as % of home value. Default 1.1.

rate.description: Annual interest rate, e.g. 6.5. If omitted, best market rate for the state is used.

state.description: 2-letter US state code for the market-rate lookup. Default CA.

name: estimate_monthly_cost

annual_total.description: Twelve months of the total monthly payment, in dollars.

assumed_defaults.description: Inputs the caller did not supply that were filled in with defaults. State these explicitly to the user, since they drive the numbers.

annual_insurance.description: Annual homeowners insurance premium in dollars assumed.

monthly_hoa.description: Monthly HOA dues in dollars assumed.

pmi_rate.description: Annual PMI rate assumed, as a percent of the loan balance.

property_tax_rate.description: Annual property tax rate assumed, as a percent string. Real county rates vary widely from this.

state.description: State code assumed for market-rate lookups because the caller did not supply one.

term_months.description: Loan term in months assumed because the caller did not supply one.

breakdown.description: Share of the total monthly payment taken by each component, as percent strings.

hoa_pct.description: Share of the total payment that is HOA dues.

insurance_pct.description: Share of the total payment that is homeowners insurance.

p_and_i_pct.description: Share of the total payment that is principal and interest.

pmi_pct.description: Share of the total payment that is PMI; '0%' when PMI does not apply.

tax_pct.description: Share of the total payment that is property tax.

disclosures.description: Caveats and assumptions that must accompany any answer built from this result; surface them rather than dropping them.

down_payment.description: Cash in dollars put down at closing.

home_price.description: Purchase price in dollars, as a formatted string.

loan_amount.description: Amount borrowed in dollars, being the home price less the down payment.

ltv.description: Loan-to-value ratio as a percent string. PMI generally applies above 80%.

monthly_hoa.description: Monthly HOA dues in dollars, as supplied or defaulted.

monthly_insurance.description: Monthly homeowners insurance in dollars, one twelfth of the annual premium used.

monthly_pmi.description: Monthly private mortgage insurance in dollars. $0 when LTV is at or below 80%.

monthly_property_tax.description: Estimated monthly property tax in dollars, derived from the assumed tax rate rather than an actual county assessment.

next_actions.description: Suggested follow-up tools that would deepen this answer; offer them as next steps, not as results.

tool.description: Name of the follow-up MCP tool to call next.

why.description: One-line reason this follow-up tool would be useful given the current result.

pmi_applies.description: True when the LTV requires private mortgage insurance.

principal_and_interest.description: Monthly principal-and-interest payment in dollars — only part of the total housing cost.

rate_source.description: Where rate_used came from: 'provided' means the caller supplied it, 'market' means it was resolved from the best live published rate for this state and product.

rate_used.description: Interest rate, in percent, used for every calculation in this result. Check rate_source to see whether it came from the caller or from live market data.

total_monthly_payment.description: Full monthly housing cost in dollars: principal, interest, taxes, insurance, plus PMI and HOA where they apply.
